chapter: New York: Bird and the loft years
title: Loft visitors, Mingus and Max send her to Tristano, Duke's decline, daughter Traci
summary: Sonny and Monk visited the loft; Mingus and Max recommended Lennie Tristano; Duke drifted away and she took herself to the hospital when Traci was born in 1955.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Who were some of the others?

Oh, Sonny came up to the loft. And Monk came up to the loft. Uh, and then I got, as I said, then I met Mingus, and Mingus and Max were the… Well, Max knew me from Detroit as a kid. But those were the two musicians that recommended that I go, recommended that I go to Lennie Tristano. So that‟s how I got to Lennie Tristano. Charlie Mingus took me there. And that‟s how I started studying with Lennie. And by this time, Duke was in and out, you know. His, his disease took over and, uh, I don‟t know. He went and lived with somebody else in Brooklyn and, you know… I was still married to him but, you know, it was…
Wow, what a period. I‟m just… when, when was Traci born?
But I took myself to the hospital when Traci was born, „cause Duke was not there, you know.
